items.title: Aletheia tackles FirstProof autonomously
items.summary: Aletheia, a mathematics research agent powered by Gemini 3 Deep Think, autonomously solved 6 of 10 FirstProof problems within the challenge time limit according to majority expert assessments; experts were not unanimous only on Problem 8. The authors disclose their interpretation, experiments and evaluation, and release raw prompts and outputs.

items.title: How Robustly do LLMs Understand Execution Semantics?
items.title_zh: LLM 对执行语义的理解有多鲁棒？
items.summary: The authors probe whether LLMs rely on internal world models or pattern matching by perturbing code and inputs in a program-output prediction task. DeepSeek-R1-family reasoning models stay stable at 38% to 67% accuracy, while GPT-5.2 falls from 99% on unperturbed CRUXEval by 20% to 24% under perturbation, and exception prediction is especially weak.

items.title: On Data Engineering for Scaling LLM Terminal Capabilities
items.title_zh: 面向 LLM 终端能力扩展的数据工程
items.summary: The authors present Terminal-Task-Gen, a synthetic task generation pipeline for terminal agents, and analyze filtering, curriculum learning, long-context training and scaling. Training Nemotron-Terminal models initialized from Qwen3 8B, 14B and 32B on the resulting Terminal-Corpus lifts Terminal-Bench 2.0 scores from 2.5% to 13.0%, 4.0% to 20.2% and 3.4% to 27.4% respectively, with checkpoints and most synthetic data open-sourced.

items.title: A Benchmark for Deep Information Synthesis
items.summary: DEEPSYNTH is a benchmark of 120 tasks across 7 domains and 67 countries that requires agents to gather, synthesize and reason over multi-source information into verifiable insights. Eleven state-of-the-art LLMs and deep research agents reach at most 8.97 F1 and 17.5 on an LLM-judge metric, with hallucinations and reasoning over large information spaces as key failures.

items.title: Adversarial Intent is a Latent Variable: Stateful Trust Inference for Securing Multimodal Agentic RAG
items.title_zh: 对抗意图是隐变量：面向多模态 Agentic RAG 的状态化信任推断
items.summary: The paper models security for multimodal agentic RAG as a partially observable Markov decision process with adversarial intent as a latent variable. Its Modular Trust Agent reports a 6.50x average reduction in attack success rate across 43,774 instances with negligible utility cost.

items.title: Learning from Trials and Errors: Reflective Test-Time Planning for Embodied LLMs
items.title_zh: 从试错中学习：具身 LLM 的反思式测试时规划
items.summary: The authors introduce Reflective Test-Time Planning, combining reflection-in-action, which generates and scores candidate actions before execution, with reflection-on-action, which updates the reflection model and policy after execution; retrospective reflection supports long-horizon credit assignment. Experiments on a Long-Horizon Household benchmark and MuJoCo Cupboard Fitting show gains, with zero-shot transfer to HM3D and real-robot tests on a Franka Panda arm.

items.title: Leveraging GenAI for Segmenting and Labeling Centuries-old Technical Documents
items.title_zh: 利用生成式 AI 分割与标注数百年历史的技术文献
items.summary: The authors report ongoing work on segmenting and labeling images from 16th- and 17th-century shipbuilding treatises, using SAM2 for segmentation, Florence2 and ChatGPT for labeling, and the ontoShip ontology and glosShip glossary to improve labeling. They describe preliminary results for curation and retrieval of historical documents along with limitations.

items.title: Prompt-Level Distillation: A Non-Parametric Alternative to Model Fine-Tuning for Efficient Reasoning
items.title_zh: 提示级蒸馏：高效推理中模型微调的非参数替代方案
items.summary: Prompt-Level Distillation extracts explicit reasoning patterns from a teacher model and organizes them into expressive system-prompt instructions for a student, avoiding fine-tuning. With Gemma-3 4B it raises Macro F1 on StereoSet from 57% to 90.0% and Contract-NLI from 67% to 83%, lifts LogiQA accuracy to 70%, and shows similar results with Mistral Small 3.1.

items.title: Panniantong/Agent-Reach
items.title_zh: Panniantong/Agent-Reach：让 AI Agent 读取全网内容
items.summary: Agent-Reach is a command-line tool that lets AI agents read and search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili and XiaoHongShu without API fees.
